document_kind: fixture acquisition design, not an executed acceptance manifest

aur_packages.selection_reason: Immediate canonical parent has consistent 3.10.0-1 metadata and the same 3.10.0 source; observed HEAD has PKGBUILD 3.10.0-2 but .SRCINFO 3.10.0-1. Collection ack request is unrestricted.

remaining_gates: Acquire archives, verify recorded digests and signatures, and review all executable recipe inputs before building.
Build and verify AUR artifacts and CPython 3.12.16 in the disposable guest; record artifacts, actual inventory and modules.
Acquire image layers and assemble sanitized fixture input bundles and generated credentials; run exact application checks.
Record actual virtual hardware, firmware and assembled disk hashes; create restore points and verify runtime predicates.
Bind the product implementation revision and its failure-injection interfaces; no acceptance scenario has run.

limitations: This is current anonymous registry metadata availability evidence, not complete image acquisition.
Layer availability and layer contents were not checked; descriptor counts do not establish layer availability.
Matching digests establish content identity, not publisher trust or signature verification.
No container execution, runtime compatibility, application readiness or fixture behavior was tested.
Registry metadata does not establish current live server state or reconstruct the original deployment invocation environment.
Version strings are extracted public image labels, not executable-version probes.
The observed index digest, selected platform-manifest digest and configuration digest are distinct identities.
Later fixture acquisition must revalidate metadata and acquire all required content in its authorized isolated environment.

source_tag_resolution.limitation: GitHub tag resolution was checked independently; no claim of reproducing or verifying the executable image build from this source commit

proposed_fixture_inputs.credential_reference: fixture-radarr-api-key; private fixture-only value, not a production credential

proposed_setup.naming_check: GET /api/v3/config/naming must return movieFolderFormat equal to {Movie Title} ({Release Year})
proposed_setup.capture: Positive returned root-folder id, then verify the read predicate
writes: Validates writability by creating and deleting radarr_write_test.txt inside the root; reserve this filename in the empty fixture root
proposed_setup.source_openapi_discrepancy: Generated OpenAPI lists POST 200, while controller uses CreatedAtAction; fixture assembly must verify actual 201 behavior rather than treating the generated response list as runtime proof

predicates: Returned id equals saved root-folder id
Returned path equals the fixture root path
unmappedFolders contains an entry with the exact sentinel name and full path
proposed_repeated_check.on_timeout_missing_sentinel_or_other_fai: Fail and stop the scenario; do not issue overlapping retries

source_findings: Each id GET invokes RootFolderService.Get, GetDetails, GetUnmappedFolders, DiskProviderBase.GetDirectories and Directory.EnumerateDirectories.
MovieFolderFormat slash count controls traversal depth; require the specified no-slash naming format.
The enumeration ignores inaccessible entries, so accessible alone is insufficient; require the exact sentinel.
timeout=true bounds Task.Wait to 5000 milliseconds but does not cancel its underlying task.
The selected path performs local repository and filesystem operations; no movie lookup, import or download operation is requested.
limitations: This predicate demonstrates application directory discovery, not media-file reading, importing, downloading or post-change writability.
Fixture startup, background activity, credentials, exact response behavior and process/listener attribution still require isolated execution verification.
Timeout bounds the client check, not a guarantee that Radarr background filesystem work stopped.
